daily_cumulative_semantics: next-close labels span entry day to next trading day's close, so cumulative acceptance scales next-close bps by the daily capital fraction before linear cumulative summation. Without explicit capacity settings this falls back to 1 / next_close_capital_divisor

overlay_acceptance.reason: short pool excess is omitted because A-share T+1 makes short-horizon cash PnL non-tradable; next IC is omitted because this model is not trained to rank next-day returns directly

market_cumulative.definition: universe pool_next_mean_bps scaled by daily_capital_fraction and cumulatively summed

cumulative_acceptance.market_series: full A-share market average overnight return
cumulative_acceptance.background_series: pool_L background overnight return after pool_fee_bps is drawn in the top panel. In pool_l relative mode, one pool_L curve is drawn for each decision window and each model is compared with its matching curve; the resulting pool_L zero lines are omitted from the bottom panel. In market mode, the single baseline pool_L curve is drawn relative to market
cumulative_acceptance.reason: short cumulative is omitted because this workflow cannot trade T+0
cumulative_acceptance.capacity_definition: In TopN mode, model lines use selected TopN pool-internal summaries.
cumulative_acceptance.absolute_definition: top panel plots market, pool background, baseline selected TopN, and comparison selected TopN cumulative next-close returns. Pool/model lines subtract their realized fee before dividing by next_close_capital_divisor and cumulative summation; market uses universe pool_next_mean_bps without a trading fee. Figure axis displays cumulative bps divided by 100 as percent
cumulative_acceptance.background_definition: pool_L background overnight return minus pool_fee_bps; pool fee uses equal-weight stock-pool membership turnover when available
cumulative_acceptance.pool_turnover_source: see pool_turnover_source column in cumulative plot data
cumulative_acceptance.relative_definition: bottom panel plots each model's capital-adjusted cumulative net return minus its matching window-specific pool_L capital-adjusted cumulative net return, displayed as percent; every matching pool_L curve is visible in the top panel, while their zero lines are omitted from the bottom panel; model and pool_L fees are included
cumulative_acceptance.pool_l_excess_definition: bottom panel plots each model's capital-adjusted cumulative net return minus its matching window-specific pool_L capital-adjusted cumulative net return, displayed as percent; every matching pool_L curve is visible in the top panel, while their zero lines are omitted from the bottom panel; model and pool_L fees are included
cumulative_acceptance.accumulation_definition: capital-adjusted cumulative net bps = cumsum(daily_net_bps * daily_capital_fraction)
